verdict.rationale: The core Google Cloud platform is not shown to be open source. The only evidence of openly readable source covers peripheral tooling: MCP Toolbox for Databases is explicitly described as open source on GitHub, and a Cloud Run MCP server repo is hosted on GitHub with no license stated. missing for 10: open-license source for the core platform/services, explicit license terms (e.g. Apache/MIT) for the gcloud CLI and client libraries, any evidence of an open license for the cloud-run-mcp repo.
